attributes.letter:
Dear Morgan Lee,

On behalf of the Company, I am delighted to offer you the position of **Platform Engineer**.

## Compensation

Your annualized base salary will be **$172,000**, paid in accordance with our standard payroll schedule, subject to applicable withholdings. You will also be eligible for our standard benefits program from your first day.

## Start date

Your anticipated start date is **August 24, 2026**. If you need to adjust this date, let us know and we will do our best to accommodate.

## Accepting this offer

This offer remains open until **August 14, 2026**. To accept, reply to this letter in writing before that date. This offer is contingent on satisfactory completion of your background check and proof of eligibility to work.

We are excited about what you will bring to the team, and we hope you will join us.

Sincerely,

The the Company Talent Team
